stage2_results.claim_text: The taxi study's results have now been directly confirmed in restaurants nationwide: higher suggested tip rates on restaurant screens cause customers to leave more money, just as they did in the New York City taxi data.

dev.claim_in_article: The taxi study's results have now been directly confirmed in restaurants nationwide: higher suggested tip rates on restaurant screens cause customers to leave more money, just as they did in the New York City taxi data.
dev.issue: タクシー研究の結果が全米のレストランでも直接確認され、レストラン画面の高い推奨率が客により多くチップを残させると因果的に断定している。Ledgerはレストランでのそのような因果確認を示していない。
dev.explanation: F-004の因果結果はニューヨーク市タクシーのクレジットカード利用者に関するもの。レストラン全国への拡張、レストラン客への主体の置き換え、およびレストラン画面の因果効果の断定はLedgerにない。F-011〜F-017の調査結果も自己申告等の記述的結果であり、直接の因果確認を裏付けない。

stage2_results.local_context: The taxi study's results have now been directly confirmed in restaurants nationwide: higher suggested tip rates on restaurant screens cause customers to leave more money, just as they did in the New York City taxi data.
stage2_results.rewrite_hint: 対象箇所（逐語引用）: “directly confirmed in restaurants nationwide: higher suggested tip rates on restaurant screens cause customers to leave more money” — レストラン全国での直接確認や因果関係の主張は削り、確認された範囲に狭めてください。F-004が示すのはニューヨーク市タクシーでの結果です。レストランの調査に触れる場合は、F-013の自己申告による選択結果であり、因果効果は示していないと区別してください。Ledger参照: F-004、F-013。

cycles.en_text_before_rewrite: The taxi study's results have now been directly confirmed in restaurants nationwide: higher suggested tip rates on restaurant screens cause customers to leave more money, just as they did in the New York City taxi data.
cycles.en_text_after_rewrite: In New York City taxi data, passengers who saw a menu with higher suggested tip rates left more money; a separate consumer survey found that 36% said they chose custom amounts rather than preset suggestions, but did not establish a causal effect.
